text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is well underway, and even Mejiro Ryan has had a few chance encounters with the possibility of romance. But…

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're an Umamusume! Your ears really are your most distinctive feature, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: U-um, no… That would be my hammies. When I dig my heels in running, gravel gets kicked up behind me. Cool, huh?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text: Your hammies? …What's that?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text: Hey! Why don't we watch the fireworks together? Pick you up tonight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll see you at midnight, then. Looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's way too late! The fireworks are gonna be over long before that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Really?! But… isn't this the type of thing where we promise to meet at midnight?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer C
text_block_list.text: Let's play a game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I think I know this one! Whoever says they like the other first loses, right?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer C
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a series of misunderstandings, Mejiro Ryan's hopes go down in flames.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's completely befuddled by the total rejection she's gotten.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer… I'm just too green when it comes to romance…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's no big deal if they just don't like me, but when they act like I'm a weirdo…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I'd say it's hard, It just always ends up like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Because of McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unexpectedly, she mentions the name of her lifelong rival. I decide to shut up and let her tell the story.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …It's pretty pathetic, isn't it? Always competing just to lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen's really pretty. And she knows how to coordinate an outfit too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There was a time when even I wanted to wear dresses and put ribbons in my hair.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But… I just can't measure up to her. I always lose and get hurt…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So I gave up. If people are always gonna compare our looks, then I'm better off not trying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I tossed aside everything except sports. I cut my hair short, put all my effort into workin' out…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And despite all that, she still beats me whenever we race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's had such a painful childhood. I can't help but to pat her on the back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Isn't it terrible? Being in the shadow of such a talented and pretty girl like her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I can't hold a grudge… I can't even dislike her. You know why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Because I really like McQueen. I've always looked up to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If I can't admit to myself that a good person really is good, then I'm hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Holding out until the end, even when pushed into a corner… Maybe that's Ryan's real strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You know what? It's too late. Looks like I can't make my romantic debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should just devote my life to weight lifting. Go full "no muscle, no life."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she can tackle anything in front of her, one problem at a time, like she did to make it into the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I encourage her and say she can indulge herself in romance as much as she wants.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm! Then what should I do next? I need to know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Please teach me, Trainer! What am I lacking in the romance department that I need to have a good relationship?
choice_data_list: You'll need to acquire the right knowledge.
Don't say things just for the sake of saying something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The right knowledge… Ohhh, I see. Everything I've learned about romance is from manga.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! I'm gonna start reading a whole lot of other books during summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Mejiro Ryan buries her nose in how-to books for romance every day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Hm!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mmm? Hmmmm?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I never thought of doing that before! My mind muscles are blown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Set ablaze with newfound knowledge, she turns her bashful nature into strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You mean, like, be quiet and listen? So that's what they mean by "good listener."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'll probably end up fidgeting around until I'm ready to burst. But I'll try it out tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I just have to hold my tongue and stay still! Then when someone talks to me, I'll simply listen and nod.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Come ooon… Listen good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I gotta listen more! Listen, listen, listen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What the… How's it dark out already? Is no one going to talk to me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her standing there so motionless, it makes sense that no one would talk to her. But even attempting this "exercise" shows she's got guts.
